name: Shine of Fullmoon
source:
You, who moved to 'Full Moon Village' about a year ago, is the main character of this game. You are outgoing and active, and it is your daily routine to stay outside and hang out with your friends. In such a daily life, you found out through a friend that a firework festival, a village festival, will be held on the beach in a week. You participate in preparing for the festival and join your friends. Among all the friends who are missing a screw somewhere. what choice would you make and how would you proceed the story? How to end this story is up to you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2562580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大约一年前搬到“满月村”的你是这款游戏的主角。你性格外向、活跃，每天呆在外面和朋友一起出去玩是你的惯例。在这样的日常生活中，你通过朋友得知，一周后海滩将举办烟花节，乡村节日。你参与节日的准备工作并与你的朋友一起。在所有缺了一颗螺丝的朋友中。你会做出什么选择以及你将如何继续这个故事？如何结束这个故事取决于你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2562580/]Steam[/url]]
